einzeiler: Victoria is pregnant! The hosts share their first trimesters and conception journeys.
kurzfassung: Victoria shares the news of her pregnancy alongside her close friend and co-host. They discuss the timeline of trying to conceive, the anxiety of keeping it a secret, and the physical symptoms they experienced. The episode also features listener voicemails about pregnancy secrets and the complexities of deciding to have children.
stichpunkte: Victoria and her husband planned their conception window around his demanding career schedule.
Both hosts engaged in thorough preparation, reading books and tracking ovulation.
Victoria experienced the emotional whirlwind and initial anxiety of taking a positive pregnancy test.
The hosts emphasize the importance of educating oneself on fertility rather than simply being told to relax.
Navigating early pregnancy involved dealing with unexpected physical changes and wardrobe struggles.
Listeners share personal stories regarding the secrecy of early pregnancy and the emotional weight of fertility struggles.
The episode concludes with the hosts sharing their weekly highlights of gratitude and community kindness.

clips.hook: A decade of just us, and now a new priority.
clips.text: Reflecting on the bittersweet realization that bringing a child into the world means the dynamic with a long-term partner will permanently change.

clips.hook: The worst advice you can give someone trying to conceive.
clips.text: Frustration is expressed toward the common platitude of telling women trying to get pregnant that they simply need to relax.

clips.hook: Checking online reviews while waiting for a test result.
clips.text: An early pregnancy test yields a faint line, prompting immediate skepticism based on internet product reviews.

clips.hook: A brand new body that lasts for a week and a half.
clips.text: The rapid physical changes in early pregnancy make standard clothing sizes entirely obsolete.

clips.hook: The most bubbly person makes every morning better.
clips.text: A gym receptionist brings immense joy and energy to everyone starting their morning workout routine.

beschreibung:
Vic is pregnant! And the first person to find out was not her husband. This week your besties tell you everything: you'll hear how they ended up trying to conceive at the exact same time, what it actually felt like to be the pregnant one while your best friend was still waiting, and Aubrey's soapbox on the single most infuriating piece of advice anyone gives a woman who is trying. They get into the two books that ran their whole trying to conceive era, Taking Charge of Your Fertility and Expecting Better, and everything they did to prepare for this next chapter. Vic also gets honest about the part nobody warns you about, the miscarriage anxiety in those first weeks, the worst pregnancy symptoms she’s had, plus the four affirmations she still says to her baby. Then Star 67 rings twice, and gives Vic and Aubrey a chance to help someone work through if they want to have kids or not. Subscribe and follow so you never miss an episode!
